proposals.classification: Further source evidence and an independently attributed 950-permille variant for the existing 95e conditional candidate; no duplicate count and final cross-record identity stays central.
proposals.trace: Helmet recipe calls design.validate before kernel creation and dispatch; Burgonet validation separately accepts optional course and breath descriptors through BuffeDesign. For otherwise-valid three-course defaults (upper boundary 700 per mille, overlap 5 mm), selected top-course chart height is approximately 100*(1–0.700)+5 = 35 mm, while the slot builder uses a 100 mm full-face height. An otherwise valid buffe pattern with height 820 per mille (central source assessment) or 950 per mille (prior /root/mhr_character assessment) places the zero-inclination 12 mm slots far outside that top course. If the prior kernel and other steps succeed, PiercedDomain checks hole vertices against the outer rectangle and minimum 3 mm web and returns a typed VisorOpeningSpacing error before triangulation.
proposals.bounded_arithmetic: For buffe pattern width3/count4/span54, required projected span is 4*3+3*3=21 mm and Both-side gap is 2*36–54=18 mm; one row avoids a row-spacing conflict. The separate scalar height predicate allows both 820 and 950. Center heights on the full chart are 82 and 95 mm; zero-inclination 12 mm slots have vertical extents near 76–88 and 89–101 mm respectively, well outside the approximately35 mm course. BakeSource detail and fixed CORNER_STEPS=4 produce positive segment counts, so rounded-slot vertices are emitted on this selected path. This is source and arithmetic reasoning only, not geometry execution or a fixture.
safeguards: Selected helmet recipe validates before dispatch; separate breath and course predicates reject invalid scalar ranges and spacing.
The selected pierced domain rejects points outside the outer polygon or closer than the 3 mm web before CDT, rather than silently publishing an invalid opening.

Zero slots are intentionally disabled after other scalar checks and are filtered out by the selected buffe path. A one-slot branch avoids division by count−1. Course plate_count2–3 bounds the selected three-element table and yields a nonempty face vector.
proposals.limits: Outer helmet validity, successful kernel creation, supported input persistence and actual editor/consumer error presentation are assumptions or unexamined. Editor source passes height 50–950 and separately toggles defaults; number-control implementation, UI interaction, native triangulator behavior, GPU/device, error delivery and product use were not run. The generic height validation and geometry-level failure may be intended; whether stronger design-level admission is needed is an open policy question.
